biography.value:
Radiant dragons dwell on the terraced slopes of Mount Celestia, guardians of law and goodness. They judge carefully and act decisively, and their counsel is sought by archons and mortals alike. Light pours from their mirrored scales.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .9f3yMAGLNCJXpBRR]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .LtenAo5FPD3jBCxs]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .HFXPrwsi0J5vMUf7]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=51j3AunQsD2R8HfF]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=51j3AunQsD2R8HfF]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=51j3AunQsD2R8HfF]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=F34gW6Pfi7nemvA0]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Radiant Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a lance of pure light in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=LvKSN4uJetZ5pjJE]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=LvKSN4uJetZ5pjJE]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=LvKSN4uJetZ5pjJE]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flash Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its flash Breath in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=JLVSnbqTXvP4jILb]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=JLVSnbqTXvP4jILb]] saving throw or be &Reference[blinded] for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Shadows flee the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}: it sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and creatures in the bright light can't benefit from being &Reference[invisible].

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Holy light fills a 20-foot-radius sphere; fiends and undead there must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) radiant damage.
  • The dragon names up to three creatures it can see; each gains 10 temporary hit points.
  • Each creature of the dragon's choice within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak a deliberate lie until initiative count 20 on the next round.
